SAP System Conversion and Upgrades

SAP system conversion refers to upgrading an existing SAP system to a newer version or transforming it into a different SAP environment, often associated with migrating to SAP S/4HANA. A technical upgrade updates an SAP system to a newer version without significant changes to existing business processes, customizations, or configurations, leveraging new technical features and improved performance while maintaining the existing functional landscape.

Note: The live site's 'Technical Projects We Undertake' cards (Brownfield / Bluefield / Technical Upgrades / Infrastructure Migrations) contain copy-pasted AMS descriptions rather than real conversion/upgrade descriptions. Not carried forward — see docs/CONTENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED.md item 11.

Approach

  1. 1

    Pre-Migration Planning

    Current system assessment, migration strategy, stakeholder involvement, risk assessment, and backup/recovery planning.

  2. 2

    System Preparation

    Data cleansing, data mapping and transformation, custom code analysis, and configuration documentation.

  3. 3

    Technical Migration

    Migration tools, sandbox environment, system copy and upgrade, and testing and validation.

  4. 4

    Go-Live Preparation

    Cutover planning, dry runs, stakeholder communication, and user training.

  5. 5

    Post-Migration Support

    Post go-live monitoring, issue resolution, performance optimization, documentation, and change management.
